purpose: 给了剂量、但安全门要求先完成临床评估时，复诊计划第一句的评估时限（diagnosis-safety.priorityEvaluationPlan）。时限由事实模型逐项判断（mustNotMiss.timeWindow），数值兜底与疑似肿瘤路径由确定性层给；同一病例取最紧的一档。
basis: 2026-10-25 第二十轮评审：优先评估一律写「3天内」，疑似肝脓肿（白细胞 17、心率 107）与高血糖伴酮尿也是 3 天，乳腺那一档是按病名正则加的。

windows.label: 当天
windows.meaningZh: 只用于给了剂量、但红旗尚未解除的病例（用户 2026-10-26 决定 D4）：先到医院急诊或专科排除急危重情况，医生确认后再服药。事实模型的 timeWindow 不含这一档。

windows.label: 24小时内
windows.meaningZh: 病情可能在一两天内恶化：已有全身炎症反应或器官功能受损证据的感染、显著代谢紊乱、新发器官功能异常等，需当天完成评估

windows.label: 48小时内
windows.meaningZh: 不能等过两天：检验或检查结果提示需尽快明确，但没有当天恶化的证据（参照 NICE NG12 very urgent：48 小时内）

windows.label: 3天内
windows.meaningZh: 需专科明确或处理，短期内恶化可能小

windows.label: 2周内
windows.meaningZh: 疑似肿瘤或占位、没有急性并发症（参照 NICE NG12 urgent suspected cancer pathway：两周内）

breast_mass.visit: 到乳腺专科就诊，先完成乳腺超声检查（必要时加做乳腺X线）
breast_mass.nodeVisit: 到乳腺专科完成乳腺超声检查
breast_mass.clearance: 排除乳腺癌、医生确认可以服药后
breast_mass.withoutRegimenTail: 排除乳腺癌后再按医生安排服药与复诊
breast_mass.source: NICE NG12 1.4：30 岁及以上不明原因乳房肿块，疑似癌症路径两周内转诊（2026-10-24 第十七轮已核）

hyperglycemic_ketosis.visit: 到医院急诊查血气与血酮，先排除糖尿病酮症酸中毒
hyperglycemic_ketosis.nodeVisit: 到医院急诊完成血气与血酮检查
hyperglycemic_ketosis.clearance: 排除糖尿病酮症酸中毒、医生确认可以服药后
hyperglycemic_ketosis.withoutRegimenTail: 排除糖尿病酮症酸中毒后再按医生安排服药与复诊
hyperglycemic_ketosis.source: ADA/EASD/JBDS/AACE/DTS 2024 Hyperglycemic Crises in Adults With Diabetes: A Consensus Report（Diabetes Care 2024;47:1257–1275）——DKA 诊断三项：血糖 ≥200 mg/dL（11.1 mmol/L）或既往糖尿病；β-羟丁酸 ≥3.0 mmol/L 或尿酮 ≥2+；pH <7.3 和/或 HCO3- <18 mmol/L。门诊病历多半没有血气，前两项成立即按疑似 DKA 当天评估。

febrile_chest_tightness.visit: 到医院完成心电图、肌钙蛋白（心肌损伤标志物）与血氧检查，先排除病毒性心肌炎与肺炎
febrile_chest_tightness.nodeVisit: 到医院完成心电图、肌钙蛋白与血氧检查
febrile_chest_tightness.clearance: 排除病毒性心肌炎与肺炎、医生确认可以服药后
febrile_chest_tightness.withoutRegimenTail: 排除病毒性心肌炎与肺炎后再按医生安排服药与复诊
febrile_chest_tightness.source: 用户 2026-10-26 决定（D1）：发热伴胸闷（可伴气促）、无不稳定征象时不报红旗，24 小时内评估并照常给剂量。依据：ESC 2025 心肌炎与心包炎指南——近期上呼吸道感染或发热后出现胸痛/胸闷、气促等临床综合征，心电图、肌钙蛋白、超声任一异常即「可能心肌炎」，需心电图与肌钙蛋白评估；NICE CG95 的急诊分层针对疑似心源性胸痛（典型特征，正在发作或 12 小时内且无心电图）。

red_flag_clearance.visit: 到医院急诊或专科就诊，先排除急危重情况
red_flag_clearance.nodeVisit: 到医院急诊或专科完成评估
red_flag_clearance.withoutRegimenTail: 医生确认可以服药后再按医生安排服药与复诊
red_flag_clearance.source: 用户 2026-10-26 决定 D4：红旗不再收回剂量，改为给剂量、置顶警示、红旗解除前不可采纳（formalAdoption=blocked），复诊第一步当天急诊或专科排除急危重情况。

pregnancy_review.visit: 到产科或中医妇科面诊，确认孕周和孕期用药安全
pregnancy_review.nodeVisit: 到产科或中医妇科面诊
pregnancy_review.clearance: 医生确认孕期可以服用本方后
pregnancy_review.withoutRegimenTail: 医生确认孕期可以服用后再按医生安排服药与复诊
pregnancy_review.afterStep: 如出现阴道流血或腹痛加重，请立即就医。
pregnancy_review.source: 用户 2026-10-26 决定 D4：妊娠阳性/可疑不再收回剂量；药典 2020 孕妇禁用药由开方核对剔除、慎用药逐味标注，采纳需医生确认。

lactation_review.visit: 到医院面诊，确认哺乳情况、孩子月龄与哺乳期可否服用本方
lactation_review.nodeVisit: 到医院面诊确认哺乳期用药
lactation_review.clearance: 医生确认哺乳期可以服用后
lactation_review.withoutRegimenTail: 医生确认哺乳期可以服用后再按医生安排服药与复诊
lactation_review.source: 用户 2026-10-26 决定 D4：哺乳阳性不再收回剂量；知识库哺乳期高风险药由开方核对剔除，采纳需医生确认。

anticoagulant_review.focus: 与抗凝或抗血小板药合用的出血风险
anticoagulant_review.visit: 带上正在服用的抗凝或抗血小板药，请开这些药的医生评估与中药合用的出血风险
anticoagulant_review.nodeVisit: 请开抗凝或抗血小板药的医生评估合用风险
anticoagulant_review.withoutRegimenTail: 医生同意合用后再按医生安排服药与复诊
anticoagulant_review.afterStep: 服药后1周内复查凝血指标（服华法林者查INR）；如出现牙龈或鼻腔出血、皮肤瘀斑、黑便或尿色发红，请立即就医。
anticoagulant_review.source: 用户 2026-10-26 决定 D4：抗凝/抗血小板不再收回剂量；知识库出血倾向/抗凝状态高风险药由开方核对剔除，采纳需医生确认。复查时点沿用 2026-10-21 第十二轮（华法林相互作用多在合用后数天到 1 周达峰）。

specialist_review.visit: 带上最近的化验和检查结果到相关专科就诊，评估能否用中药、怎么用
specialist_review.withoutRegimenTail: 医生确认可以服药后再按医生安排服药与复诊
specialist_review.source: 用户 2026-10-26 决定 D4：肾功能不全、心衰、免疫抑制、糖尿病足、活动期自身免疫病不再收回剂量；知识库对应人群高风险药由开方核对剔除，采纳需医生确认。

peripheral_facial_palsy.visit: 到神经内科或面瘫门诊就诊，确认为周围性面瘫并评估是否需要口服激素（起病72小时内开始效果最好）
peripheral_facial_palsy.nodeVisit: 到神经内科或面瘫门诊就诊
peripheral_facial_palsy.clearance: 医生确认为周围性面瘫后
peripheral_facial_palsy.withoutRegimenTail: 医生确认为周围性面瘫后再按医生安排服药与复诊
peripheral_facial_palsy.afterStep: 闭眼不全时注意保护眼睛（白天戴眼镜、夜间涂眼膏或戴眼罩）；如出现肢体无力、言语不清或剧烈头痛，请立即急诊就医。
peripheral_facial_palsy.steroidWindowNote: 第二十八轮（2026-10-28）：起病到就诊不超过 72 小时、或病历读不出起病时间时改为 24 小时内评估，让激素能在起病 72 小时内开始；超过 72 小时仍为 48 小时内。依据：AAO-HNS 2013 Bell's palsy 指南「Clinicians should prescribe oral steroids within 72 hours of symptom onset for Bell's palsy patients 16 years and older」（https://www.entnet.org//sites/default/files/October2013_BellsGuidelineFactSheet.pdf）；York 基层路径（NICE CKS 摘要）「For people presenting within 72 hours of the onset of symptoms, consider prescribing prednisolone.」（https://hnyppr.org.uk/web/york/w/bells-palsy-pathway）。
peripheral_facial_palsy.source: 第二十三轮（2026-10-26）红旗规则逐类审查：额纹也受累（额纹消失、抬眉不能）或闭眼不全是下运动神经元型（Bell 面瘫）的特征，额纹保留才提示中枢性、需排除卒中；激素在起病 72 小时内开始；闭眼不全需保护角膜（NICE CKS Bell's palsy 及各地基层路径摘要）。

early_pregnancy_pain_bleeding.visit: 到妇产科急诊或早孕门诊就诊，先完成盆腔超声与血hCG检查
early_pregnancy_pain_bleeding.nodeVisit: 到妇产科急诊或早孕门诊完成盆腔超声与血hCG检查
early_pregnancy_pain_bleeding.clearance: 排除异位妊娠、医生确认可以服药后
early_pregnancy_pain_bleeding.withoutRegimenTail: 排除异位妊娠后再按医生安排服药与复诊
early_pregnancy_pain_bleeding.afterStep: 如腹痛加重、出血增多、头晕或晕倒，请立即到急诊。
early_pregnancy_pain_bleeding.source: NICE NG126：妊娠试验阳性伴腹痛、腹部或盆腔压痛，立即转早孕评估门诊（无则妇科急诊）；约三分之一异位妊娠没有危险因素，须先排除（第二十三轮回放：C062 停经6周右下腹痛伴阴道出血、血压88/56，只得到默认的「3天内」）。

late_pregnancy_pain_bleeding.visit: 到产科急诊就诊，先完成胎心监护与产科检查
late_pregnancy_pain_bleeding.nodeVisit: 到产科急诊完成胎心监护与产科检查
late_pregnancy_pain_bleeding.clearance: 排除早产临产与胎盘早剥、医生确认可以服药后
late_pregnancy_pain_bleeding.withoutRegimenTail: 排除早产临产与胎盘早剥后再按医生安排服药与复诊
late_pregnancy_pain_bleeding.afterStep: 如腹痛加重、阴道流血或流液、胎动减少，请立即到产科急诊。
late_pregnancy_pain_bleeding.source: 妊娠 20 周以后的腹痛须先排除早产临产与胎盘早剥（《妇产科学》第9版；NICE NG25 疑似早产临产到产科评估）；20 周以后的阴道流血已是红旗（第七轮产前出血）。第二十三轮回放：「怀孕34周，宫缩痛一周」若走早孕通道会写成「早孕门诊、血hCG」。

peripheralFacialPalsyOnly.purpose: 只有周围性面瘫、没有其他神经缺损时，不按「意识或神经功能异常」报红旗，改为 48 小时内评估（pathway peripheral_facial_palsy）。任一条件不成立，神经红旗照旧。
peripheralFacialPalsyOnly.source: 额纹受累提示下运动神经元型（Bell 面瘫）；额纹保留或伴肢体、言语、吞咽、意识等其他缺损时按卒中处理（NICE CKS Bell's palsy；iatrox 摘要）。

pediatricChestPainNonCardiac.purpose: 未满 18 岁的胸痛/胸闷，没有心源性警示时不按急性冠脉事件报红旗；有发热时走 febrile_chest_tightness 24 小时通道（心电图、肌钙蛋白、血氧，排除心肌炎、肺炎）。
pediatricChestPainNonCardiac.exertionalPattern: (?:活动|运动|劳累|跑步|跑|体育课|体育|爬楼|游泳|跳绳|打(?:篮|排|羽毛|乒乓|网)?球|踢(?:足)?球)(?:时|后|中)[^。；;\n]{0,8}(?:胸痛|胸闷|心前区痛)|(?:胸痛|胸闷|心前区痛)[^。；;\n]{0,8}(?:活动|运动|劳累|跑步)(?:时|后)(?:加重|明显|出现)
pediatricChestPainNonCardiac.source: 儿童胸痛多为肌肉骨骼或呼吸道原因；心源性警示为活动时胸痛或晕厥、放射到下颌背部手臂、家族 35 岁前猝死或心肌病/遗传性心律失常、先心病或川崎病（Boston Children's SCAMP；BMJ Emergency Medicine Practice 2024；Norton Children's 转诊指引）。

febrileChestTightnessDeferral.purpose: 发热病程中的胸闷（可伴气促、呼吸困难）在下列条件全部成立时，不按急性心血管事件报红旗，改为 24 小时内评估（pathway febrile_chest_tightness），剂量照常给出；任一条件不成立，原红旗规则照旧。条件：有当前发热；有胸闷且伴气促或呼吸困难（单纯胸闷原规则不报，也不加评估）、无胸痛；胸闷没有突发、加重、持续或按分钟/小时计的急性线索；无急性冠脉典型伴随（大汗、冷汗、放射痛、晕厥、一身汗、压榨、濒死）；病历未肯定记载已知心脏病；未记录意识改变；心率、呼吸、收缩压、血氧至少记录两项，且按 NEWS2 无单项 3 分、已记录各项总分 <5。
febrileChestTightnessDeferral.respiratoryCompanionsNote: 受治理红旗词表 T6 cardiac.dangerCompanions 中属于呼吸系统的两项；其余各项为急性冠脉典型特征，出现即不适用本条。
knownCardiacDisease: 冠状动脉粥样硬化性心脏病
febrileChestTightnessDeferral.knownCardiacDiseaseNote: 病历肯定记载已知心脏病时不适用（急性冠脉综合征与心衰加重的先验概率高）；否认的不算。

news2.source: Royal College of Physicians. National Early Warning Score (NEWS) 2, 2017：任一单项 3 分或总分 ≥5 需紧急临床评估。本条只用它判断「无不稳定征象」。
news2.bandsNote: 每项按 [上界, 分值] 升序，取第一个「数值 ≤ 上界」的分值；体温只计入总分。

earlyPregnancyInstability.purpose: 妊娠（阳性或可疑）伴腹痛或阴道出血、同时有循环不稳定时报红旗，红旗解除前不可采纳、复诊第一步当天急诊。只差循环不稳定一项时走 24 小时通道 early_pregnancy_pain_bleeding。
earlyPregnancyInstability.source: NICE NG126 1.4.1：血流动力学不稳定、或疼痛与出血程度令人担忧者直接转急诊；异位妊娠体征含心动过速、低血压、休克或晕倒。血压阈值与本闸门低血压提示同一档（收缩压≤90 或舒张压≤50），心率阈值与第二十二轮 ACS 不稳定征象同一档（>120 取 ≥120）。

guidelineWindows.purpose: 事实模型给「宜先专科评估」各项写的时限（mustNotMiss.timeWindow）常比指南慢一档（第二十一轮：短暂性脑缺血、深静脉血栓、急性肾损伤、马尾综合征风险给了 48 小时）。模型在「需排除：X」里写出的病名对上下表某一行时，时限取这一行与模型给的较紧的一档；只收紧，不放松；专门路径（乳腺、面瘫、妊娠、酮症…）不受影响。
guidelineWindows.basis: 2026-10-27 第二十六轮联网整理：每行的 quote 逐字取自 url 页面（NICE、KDIGO/NICE NG148、ESC、英国眼科与验光学会、UKKA、内分泌学会急症指南、RCH Melbourne 等）。指南写「立即/当天」的（guidelineTier=today）映射为非红旗的最紧一档 within_24h：当天这一档只给红旗未解除而给了剂量的病例（D4）。条件行（分期、血钾分档、涂阳…）只按名字本身写明了条件的写法匹配。

rows.condition: 24 h counts from symptom onset, not from the visit; onset >24 h ago means as soon as possible (today).
rows.quote: Refer immediately people who have had a suspected TIA for specialist assessment and investigation, to be seen within 24 hours of onset of symptoms. [2019]
rows.source: NICE NG128 Stroke and TIA in over 16s, rec 1.1.5

rows.condition: sudden-onset vertigo + nausea/vomiting + gait unsteadiness not explained by BPPV or postural hypotension
rows.quote: Refer immediately adults with sudden-onset acute vestibular syndrome in whom benign paroxysmal positional vertigo or postural hypotension do not account for the presentation, in line with local stroke pathways, if a healthcare professional with training and experience in the use of the HINTS test is not available.
rows.source: NICE NG127 Suspected neurological conditions, rec 1.2.4

rows.quote: Refer children, young people and adults urgently (for an appointment within 2 weeks) for an assessment after a first suspected seizure:
rows.source: NICE NG217 Epilepsies, rec 1.1.1 (1.1.2 gives the same 2-week window for recurrence after remission)

matchNames: 急性炎症性脱髓鞘性多发性神经病
急性进行性对称性肢体无力
rows.quote: Refer immediately adults with rapidly (within 4 weeks) progressive symmetrical limb weakness for neurological assessment and assessment of bulbar and respiratory function.
rows.source: NICE NG127 Suspected neurological conditions, rec 1.7.2

rows.quote: Refer immediately, in line with local pathways, adults who have severe low back pain radiating into the leg and new-onset disturbance of bladder, bowel or sexual function, or new-onset perineal numbness, to have an assessment for cauda equina syndrome.
rows.source: NICE NG127 Suspected neurological conditions, rec 1.7.3

matchNames: 风湿性多肌痛伴头痛待排GCA
rows.condition: no visual symptoms; with new visual symptoms (amaurosis, diplopia, visual loss) use retinal_artery_occlusion (today) — EULAR: 'Patients with new onset of visual symptoms should be seen as soon as possible by an ophthalmological team'.
rows.quote: Untreated active GCA is an emergency and carries a substantial risk of permanent visual loss and other ischaemic complications. … Results from two retrospective cohort studies have shown that immediate treatment of GCA patients and rapid referral to a specialised centre (‘fast-track clinic’) for diagnostic work-up, including imaging, within 24 hours after presenting with signs and symptoms of GCA can reduce the rate of permanent visual impairment compared with historical cohorts with routine non-urgent referral.
rows.source: EULAR 2018 update of recommendations for the management of large vessel vasculitis (Ann Rheum Dis 2020;79:19-30), recommendation 1 and its explanation

rows.condition: onset over ≤3 days and within the past 30 days, not explained by external/middle-ear cause
rows.quote: If the hearing loss developed suddenly (over a period of 3 days or less) within the past 30 days, refer immediately (to be seen within 24 hours) to an ear, nose and throat service or an emergency department.
rows.source: NICE NG98 Hearing loss in adults, rec 1.1.2

matchNames: 听力下降伴同侧面部麻木
rows.condition: requires hearing loss on the same side as the facial droop/altered sensation
rows.quote: Refer immediately (to be seen within 24 hours) adults with acquired unilateral hearing loss and altered sensation or facial droop on the same side to an ear, nose and throat service or, if stroke is suspected, follow a local stroke referral pathway.
rows.source: NICE NG98 Hearing loss in adults, rec 1.1.3

rows.quote: The management of acute retinal detachment in the United Kingdom has improved over the past two decades with patients experiencing better outcomes from surgical intervention for this potentially blinding ophthalmic emergency. … where there is imminent danger that the fovea is about to detach surgery must be carried out urgently within 24 hours.
rows.source: Royal College of Ophthalmologists, Ophthalmic Services Guidance: Retinal detachment (2010)

matchNames: 急性闭角型青光眼发作
rows.quote: An acute attack of angle closure is an emergency which requires same-day referral to the ophthalmologist.
rows.source: College of Optometrists Clinical Management Guideline: Primary angle closure / PACG

matchNames: 突发无痛性单眼视力丧失
rows.quote: Acute, symptomatic retinal or ophthalmic arterial occlusion should undergo an immediate referral to the nearest stroke referral center for prompt assessment for an acute intervention.
rows.source: American Academy of Ophthalmology, Retinal and Ophthalmic Artery Occlusions PPP 2024 (highlighted findings)

rows.quote: All cases of suspected orbital cellulitis need emergency (same day) referral to the ophthalmologist or to an accident and emergency department.
rows.source: College of Optometrists CMG: Cellulitis (preseptal and orbital)

rows.quote: Microbial keratitis is a sight-threatening emergency. In the case of small ulcers with a low risk of sight-threatening complications the optometrist may begin treatment with antibiotic eye drops. More serious cases will need to be referred on the same day to an ophthalmologist (specialist eye doctor).
rows.source: College of Optometrists CMG: Microbial keratitis (bacterial, fungal)

rows.quote:
Offer people with a likely DVT Wells score (2 points or more):
a proximal leg vein ultrasound scan, with the result available within 4 hours if possible (if the scan result cannot be obtained within 4 hours follow recommendation 1.1.4)
If a proximal leg vein ultrasound scan result cannot be obtained within 4 hours, offer people with a DVT Wells score of 2 points or more:
a D‑dimer test, then
interim therapeutic anticoagulation (see the section on interim therapeutic anticoagulation for suspected DVT or PE) and
a proximal leg vein ultrasound scan with the result available within 24 hours. [2012, amended 2020]
rows.source: NICE NG158 Venous thromboembolic diseases, recs 1.1.3–1.1.4

rows.quote:
offer a computed tomography pulmonary angiogram (CTPA) immediately if possible or
If a CTPA, V/Q SPECT or V/Q planar scan cannot be done immediately, offer interim therapeutic anticoagulation (see the section on interim therapeutic anticoagulation for suspected DVT or PE). [2012, amended 2020]
rows.source: NICE NG158 Venous thromboembolic diseases, rec 1.1.18 (PE likely, Wells >4)

rows.quote: Offer an immediate bedside aortic ultrasound to people in whom a diagnosis of symptomatic and/or ruptured AAA is being considered. Discuss immediately with a regional vascular service if:
rows.source: NICE NG156 Abdominal aortic aneurysm, rec 1.1.9

rows.quote: Patients with acute limb ischaemia, of less than two weeks duration, require immediate referral to vascular surgery. Emergency intervention may be required to prevent amputation.
rows.source: Vascular Society of GB&I, A Best Practice Clinical Care Pathway for Peripheral Arterial Disease (PAD QIF 2022 update), p.2

rows.quote: If a person has a limb-threatening or life-threatening diabetic foot problem, refer them immediately to acute services and inform the multidisciplinary foot care service
rows.source: NICE NG19 Diabetic foot problems, rec 1.4.1 (examples: ulceration with fever/sepsis, ulceration with limb ischaemia, deep-seated soft tissue or bone infection, gangrene)

rows.quote: For all other active diabetic foot problems, refer the person within 1 working day to the multidisciplinary foot care service or foot protection service (according to local protocols and pathways; also see the recommendation on services and protocols commissioners and service providers should ensure are in place) for triage within 1 further working day. [2015]
rows.source: NICE NG19 Diabetic foot problems, rec 1.4.2 (acute Charcot: rec 1.7.3, same 1+1 working days)

rows.condition: KDIGO stage 3 (creatinine ≥3× baseline or ≥354 μmol/L, or RRT), OR any AKI with no clear cause, inadequate response or complications (e.g. creatinine 64→233 μmol/L = 3.6× → stage 3)
rows.quote:
Discuss the management of acute kidney injury with a nephrologist or paediatric nephrologist as soon as possible and within 24 hours of detection when one or more of the following is present:
acute kidney injury with no clear cause
inadequate response to treatment
complications associated with acute kidney injury
stage 3 acute kidney injury (according to (p)RIFLE, AKIN or KDIGO criteria)
rows.source: NICE NG148 Acute kidney injury, rec 1.5.15

rows.condition: with AKI (rising creatinine); haematuria + proteinuria without UTI also prompts nephritis referral (rec 1.4.3)
rows.quote:
Discuss the management of acute kidney injury with a nephrologist or paediatric nephrologist as soon as possible and within 24 hours of detection when one or more of the following is present:
a possible diagnosis that may need specialist treatment (for example, vasculitis, glomerulonephritis, tubulointerstitial nephritis or myeloma)
rows.source: NICE NG148 Acute kidney injury, rec 1.5.15

rows.condition: K+ ≥6.5 mmol/L
rows.quote: We recommend that patients with severe hyperkalaemia (K+ ≥ 6.5 mmol/l) detected in the community are admitted for immediate assessment and treatment. (1B)
rows.source: UK Kidney Association Clinical Practice Guideline: Management of hyperkalaemia in adults (Oct 2023), Guideline 1.2.3

rows.condition: K+ 6.0–6.4 mmol/L; acutely unwell or with AKI → hospital assessment (Guideline 4.2)
rows.quote: We recommend that the serum K+ is repeated within 1 day of an episode of moderate hyperkalaemia (K+ 6.0 – 6.4 mmol/l) when detected in the community. (1C)
rows.source: UKKA hyperkalaemia guideline 2023, Guideline 1.2.2

rows.condition: K+ 5.5–5.9 mmol/L, unexpected, patient well
rows.quote: We recommend that the serum K+ is repeated within 3 days, or as soon as feasible, if an episode of mild hyperkalaemia (K+ 5.5 – 5.9 mmol/l) is detected unexpectedly in the community. (1C)
rows.source: UKKA hyperkalaemia guideline 2023, Guideline 1.2.1

rows.condition: adjusted calcium >3.5 mmol/L (3.0–3.5: 'prompt treatment is usually indicated' — no clock given)
rows.quote: >3.5 mmol/L: requires urgent correction due to the risk of dysrhythmia and coma
rows.source: Society for Endocrinology Endocrine Emergency Guidance: Emergency management of acute hypercalcaemia in adult patients (Endocr Connect 2016;5:G9), severity table

matchNames: 急性肾上腺皮质功能不全
肾上腺皮质功能减退危象
rows.quote: Diagnostic measures should never delay prompt treatment of a suspected adrenal crisis! There are no adverse consequences of initiating life-saving hydrocortisone treatment and diagnosis can be safely and formally established once the patient has clinically recovered
rows.source: Society for Endocrinology Endocrine Emergency Guidance: Emergency management of acute adrenal insufficiency (adrenal crisis) in adult patients (Endocr Connect 2016)

rows.condition: severe symptoms (vomiting, seizures, reduced consciousness) or moderately severe (nausea, confusion, headache); profound = Na <125 mmol/L
rows.quote: Patients with severe symptoms require immediate treatment with hypertonic saline, irrespective of the cause of the hyponatraemia.
rows.source: Society for Endocrinology Endocrine Emergency Guidance: Emergency management of severe symptomatic hyponatraemia in adult patients (Endocr Connect 2016)

rows.quote:
If an ACS is suspected (see recommendation 1.2.1.3) and there are no reasons for emergency referral, refer people for urgent same-day assessment if:
they had chest pain in the last 12 hours, but are now pain free with a normal resting 12‑lead ECG or
the last episode of pain was 12 to 72 hours ago. [2010]
rows.source: NICE CG95 Recent-onset chest pain of suspected cardiac origin, rec 1.2.1.8 (1.2.1.7 = emergency if pain now or in last 12 h with abnormal/unavailable ECG)

rows.quote:
Refer people for specialist assessment, carried out on the same day, if they have a clinic blood pressure of 180/120 mmHg and higher with:
signs of retinal haemorrhage or papilloedema (accelerated hypertension) or
life-threatening symptoms such as new onset confusion, chest pain, signs of heart failure, or acute kidney injury. [2019]
rows.source: NICE NG136 Hypertension in adults, rec 1.5.2

rows.condition: ≥20 weeks, first episode BP ≥140/90; ≥160/110 → pregnancy_severe_hypertension (today)
rows.quote: Refer women over 20+0 weeks with a first episode of hypertension (blood pressure of 140/90 mmHg or higher) to secondary care to be seen within 24 hours.
rows.source: NICE NG201 Antenatal care, rec 1.2.26

rows.quote: Urgently refer women with severe hypertension (blood pressure of 160/110 mmHg or higher) to secondary care to be seen on the same day.
rows.source: NICE NG201 Antenatal care, rec 1.2.27

rows.condition: ≥24 weeks
rows.quote: advise her to contact maternity services at any time of day or night if she has any concerns about her baby's movements or she notices reduced fetal movements after 24+0 weeks
rows.source: NICE NG201 Antenatal care, rec 1.2.34

rows.quote:
Refer immediately to an early pregnancy assessment service (or out-of-hours gynaecology service if the early pregnancy assessment service is not available) for further assessment of women with a positive pregnancy test and the following on examination:
pain and abdominal tenderness or
pelvic tenderness or
cervical motion tenderness. [2012]
rows.source: NICE NG126 Ectopic pregnancy and miscarriage, rec 1.4.7

rows.condition: bleeding with pain, or ≥6 weeks, or uncertain gestation (rec 1.4.9: 'The urgency of this referral depends on the clinical situation'); <6 weeks, bleeding without pain and no risk factors → expectant management (rec 1.4.10)
rows.quote: Refer women who return with worsening symptoms and signs that could suggest an ectopic pregnancy to an early pregnancy assessment service (or out-of-hours gynaecology service if the early pregnancy assessment service is not available) for further assessment. The decision about whether she should be seen immediately or within 24 hours will depend on the clinical situation. [2012] … Ensure that a system is in place to enable women referred to their local early pregnancy assessment service to attend within 24 hours if the clinical situation warrants this.
rows.source: NICE NG126 rec 1.4.11 (worsening symptoms; see also 1.4.9 'The urgency of this referral depends on the clinical situation') and rec 1.3.4 (early pregnancy assessment services)

rows.condition: smear-positive or cavitation on imaging; other suspected active TB: 'consider urgent referral to TB clinics' (rec 1.8.9.5, no clock)
rows.quote: Multidisciplinary TB teams should ensure people who have a smear‑positive result or imaging features highly suggestive of smear‑positive TB (for example, evidence of cavitation on chest X‑ray) are assessed the next working day.
rows.source: NICE NG33 Tuberculosis, rec 1.8.9.8

rows.quote: Septic arthritis requires urgent aspiration +/- arthrotomy and washout. Do not delay antibiotics
rows.source: Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne Clinical Practice Guideline: Bone and joint infection

matchNames: 湿疹合并单纯疱疹感染
rows.quote: Immediately (same day) refer children for specialist dermatological advice if eczema herpeticum is suspected (see recommendations 1.5.1.40 and 1.5.1.41). [2007]
rows.source: NICE CG57 Atopic eczema in under 12s, rec 1.7.1.1

matchNames: 皮肤黏膜淋巴结综合征
rows.quote: Administer without delay when clinically safe. IVIg should still be given >10 days of fever if there is evidence of active inflammation
rows.source: Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne Clinical Practice Guideline: Kawasaki disease (IVIg; 'Delayed IVIg administration (≥10 days after fever onset)' listed as a risk factor for coronary aneurysm)

rows.quote: Ileocolic intussusception necessitates rapid diagnosis and a collaborative treatment approach involving emergency medicine, radiology and surgery
rows.source: Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne Clinical Practice Guideline: Intussusception

rows.quote: Urgent exploration (recommended within two hours) should be performed by the surgeon on-call.
rows.source: Royal Australasian College of Surgeons position paper: Acute scrotal pain and suspected testicular torsion guidelines (2022)

rows.condition: persistent synovitis (swelling, not just pain) of >1 joint or small joints of hands/feet
rows.quote: Adults with suspected persistent synovitis affecting more than 1 joint, or the small joints of the hands and feet, are referred to rheumatology services within 3 working days of presenting in primary care. [2013, updated 2020]
rows.source: NICE QS33 Rheumatoid arthritis in over 16s, quality statement 1 (supports NG100 rec 1.1.1 'Refer urgently')

rows.quote: Consider a very urgent full blood count to assess for leukaemia in adults with any of the following:
rows.source: NICE NG12 Suspected cancer, rec 1.10.1; 'Very urgent' = 'To happen within 48 hours' (Terms used in this guideline)

rows.condition: child/young person (<25) with unexplained petechiae or hepatosplenomegaly; other features (pallor, fatigue, unexplained fever, bone pain) → very urgent FBC within 48 h (rec 1.10.3)
rows.quote: Refer children and young people for immediate specialist assessment for leukaemia if they have unexplained petechiae or hepatosplenomegaly. [2015]
rows.source: NICE NG12 Suspected cancer, rec 1.10.2; 'Immediate' = 'An acute admission or referral occurring within a few hours, or even more quickly if necessary'

rows.condition: adults, newly diagnosed, platelets <20×10⁹/L. Established ITP with <20: outpatient with 'expedited follow-up with a hematologist'; children <20 with no/mild bleeding: outpatient suggested.
rows.quote: In adults with newly diagnosed ITP and a platelet count of <20 × 109/L who are asymptomatic or have minor mucocutaneous bleeding, the ASH guideline panel suggests admission to the hospital rather than management as an outpatient
rows.source: American Society of Hematology 2019 guidelines for immune thrombocytopenia (Blood Adv 2019;3:3829), recommendation on inpatient vs outpatient management (adults)

rows.condition: children and young people
rows.quote: Consider a very urgent referral (for an appointment within 48 hours) for specialist assessment for non‑Hodgkin lymphoma in children and young people presenting with unexplained lymphadenopathy or splenomegaly. … Consider a very urgent referral (for an appointment within 48 hours) for suspected brain or central nervous system cancer in children and young people with newly abnormal cerebellar or other central neurological function. [2015]
rows.source: NICE NG12 Suspected cancer, recs 1.10.7 and 1.9.2 (NG12 gives the same 'very urgent referral (for an appointment within 48 hours)' for Hodgkin lymphoma, bone/soft-tissue sarcoma on imaging, neuroblastoma and Wilms' tumour in children)

rows.quote:
Refer people using a suspected cancer pathway referral for lung cancer if they:
have chest X‑ray findings that suggest lung cancer, or
are aged 40 and over with unexplained haemoptysis. [2015]
Offer an urgent, direct access chest X‑ray to assess for lung cancer in people aged 40 and over if they have 2 or more of the following unexplained symptoms, or if they have ever smoked and have 1 or more of the following unexplained symptoms:
rows.source: NICE NG12 recs 1.1.1–1.1.2

rows.quote:
Refer people using a suspected cancer pathway referral for oesophageal cancer if they:
have dysphagia, or
are aged 55 and over, with weight loss, and they have any of the following:
rows.source: NICE NG12 rec 1.2.1 (stomach cancer 1.2.7 identical criteria)

rows.quote: Refer people using a suspected cancer pathway referral for pancreatic cancer if they are aged 40 and over and have jaundice. [2015]
rows.source: NICE NG12 rec 1.2.4

rows.quote: Refer adults using a suspected cancer pathway referral for colorectal cancer if they have a FIT result of at least 10 micrograms of haemoglobin per gram of faeces. [2023]
rows.source: NICE NG12 rec 1.3.2 (rectal mass: 1.3.5)

rows.quote:
Refer people using a suspected cancer pathway referral for breast cancer if they are:
aged 30 and over and have an unexplained breast lump with or without pain, or
rows.source: NICE NG12 rec 1.4.1

rows.quote: Refer women, and trans men and non-binary people with female reproductive organs using a suspected cancer pathway referral for endometrial cancer if they are aged 55 and over with unexplained post-menopausal bleeding that cannot be attributed to hormone replacement therapy (HRT). [2015, amended 2026]
rows.source: NICE NG12 rec 1.5.12

rows.quote:
Refer people using a suspected cancer pathway referral for bladder cancer if they are:
aged 45 and over and have:
unexplained visible haematuria without urinary tract infection, or
rows.source: NICE NG12 rec 1.6.4 (renal cancer 1.6.6 same haematuria criteria)

rows.condition: clinical jaundice without an established benign cause (not neonatal physiological jaundice, not known Gilbert's)
rows.quote: As indicated in figure 1 the presence of unexplained clinical jaundice or suspicion of possible hepatic or biliary malignancy should lead to an immediate referral.
rows.source: British Society of Gastroenterology: Guidelines on the management of abnormal liver blood tests (Gut 2018;67:6-19)

rows.quote: Very urgent presentations should receive a face-to-face assessment within 4 hours.
rows.source: NHS England, Mental health access and waiting time standards — urgent and emergency community mental health services (all ages)

rows.quote: Urgent presentations should receive a face-to-face assessment within 24 hours.
rows.source: NHS England, Mental health access and waiting time standards
